The argument for income inequality, while relevant to the general topic of wage policy, does not strongly outweigh my established concern for small business survival. I won't adopt it strongly, but I will acknowledge it somewhat since inequality is a real issue in Seattle. I'll give a slight endorsement to C_05 based on the second, more balanced speaker.

I will update C_05 to reflect a slight acceptance of the concept, but not a strong belief in the $15/hour solution to it.
